summary: First test cycle for customer auth (email/password + Google) feature. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering register, login-email, /me, heartbeat, logout, idle timeout enforcement (60min), login_events audit trail, booking auto-link by email, Google-only user adds password, and validation (422). Frontend: End-to-end Playwright flow through /signup -> /my-bookings -> logout -> /login with wrong+correct password all pass. All required data-testids are present. Header account link toggles correctly. Idle notice + last-login timestamps render. Overall implementation of the customer auth layer looks solid.

issues: Cancel uses native window.confirm() instead of a shadcn AlertDialog. Review request says 'opens confirm dialog' — functional, but inconsistent with the rest of the app which uses shadcn dialogs; consider migrating for a11y + look-and-feel.

action_items: OPTIONAL: replace window.confirm in MyBookings.handleCancel with an in-app AlertDialog so the confirm UI matches the rest of the app.
OPTIONAL: consider adding a rate-limit / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login-email (currently unlimited wrong-password attempts).

OPTIONAL: Google-only users get password added on POST /auth/register but `provider` is only flipped to 'both' when an existing provider field is present — for legacy rows lacking provider, provider becomes 'email' (loses google). Consider using $setOnInsert / conditional to keep both.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1267 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold; consider extracting auth endpoints into routes/auth.py similar to routes/admin.py and routes/payments.py.
get_current_user swallows generic Exception on last_activity parse (line ~361) — could hide bad data; log at debug level instead of pass.

logout endpoint sets samesite='none', secure=True on delete_cookie — good; but the endpoint does not require auth so a random attacker with a stolen cookie value could delete arbitrary sessions (mitigated by httpOnly + Secure, but low-risk to note).
No explicit test for concurrent register race — unique index on email exists (created in seed_db startup), so DB layer will reject dupes; good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all assertions in single scripted E2E flow passed)

test_credentials: New random customer accounts created via /api/auth/register during tests (test.customer.<ts>@example.com / Test1234!). Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md unchanged.
seed_data_creation: Test writes ephemeral users + one booking directly into MongoDB (customer_email + generated id 'bk_...') for the pre-signup auto-link test. Safe to leave; can be pruned by prefix TEST_ next cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer auth email/password flow verified end-to-end. Google auth path (/api/auth/session with X-Session-ID) not exercised because it requires the real Emergent OAuth flow — verify manually if changes are made. Idle timeout is verified by backdating last_activity_at in Mongo. Session cookies are Secure+SameSite=None so requests over http://localhost won't resend them — the pytest suite uses a BearerSession helper that promotes the cookie to Authorization: Bearer for /me & /heartbeat while still passing cookies explicitly for /logout.
